title: Train the Trainer
overview: This course is designed to equip trainers with the essential knowledge and skills needed to create and deliver effective training sessions. Participants will start by exploring the principles of adult learning, including various learning styles and trainer competencies. The curriculum covers a range of learning methods, interactive activities, program design, and culminates in the delivery of training sessions. By the end of the course, trainers will be well-prepared to engage their audiences and facilitate meaningful learning experiences.
audience: This course is intended for officers, specialists, team leaders, business partners, line managers, and trainers involved in both classroom and on-the-job training
methodology: Utilizing a practical and hands-on approach, the course encourages participants to design and develop a mini training session, which they will then present while being recorded for playback and personal reflection.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Recognize various principles of adult learning and their implications for training delivery
Identify and cultivate the skills necessary for effective trainers
Evaluate training methods and select the most suitable ones for their workshops
Implement training models in the design and execution of training programs
Create blueprints for effective training sessions
Plan and conduct a training session pertinent to their areas of expertise
